scope: Local isolated browser; external metadata fixtures and blocked images, no TV/CDP input

checks.name: All three starter cards open exact known IDs/details in one click, with no Wikidata calls and correct return focus
Enter on an empty search input opens the own keyboard without starting search
Right on an empty field reaches Keyboard, and Enter opens it
Right at the end of text reaches Keyboard without modifying text
Left/right in the middle keep normal text caret movement
Right collapses a text selection before a later boundary move
Enter with text performs exactly one bilingual search, not a duplicate form submit
IME composition Enter is left to the native input path
No player frame or unhandled JS exception during QoL checks
